title: Designing for Difference: How Human Characteristics Shape Perceptions of Collaborative Robots
reasoning: The paper evaluates human-robot interaction using ethical and moral frameworks, specifically measuring 'Procedural Fairness', 'Interpersonal Fairness', and 'prosocial' versus 'antisocial' robot behavior. It also includes 'Human Values' and 'Moral Reasoning' as core metrics in its socio-technical design framework (Figure 1).
